text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Doto came to the stands.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
We talked for a bit. ...She said Opera O 
invited her.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Telling them to come watch her play the 
"lead role."

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ――The lead role, huh.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Even in a race like this, where the 
defining Umamusume of an era gather to vie 
for the Emperor's Shield, she can still 
say such things—

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: It really is just like you, honestly.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...It's almost refreshing.
choice_data_list: I can't afford to fall behind either.
We can't afford to fall behind either.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...I have no intention of competing with 
something like that.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Well then... I'm off.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Raise your chalice. Let blessings be 
poured. Fill it to the brim with joy. Let 
wonder overflow.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Sing, birds! Shine, sun! Earth, sprout 
forth beneath my feet!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: —A 'new chapter' begins.
(W-WAAAAAAAAHHH!)

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Wait, what, really!? This is the part 
where everyone goes wild!?

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
No, I don't know!! I mean, I have no 
clue!! But somehow—

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
"Like... you know. I don't really get it, 
but like...!!"

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: ...Opera O-chan—

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...I have no intention of competing 
against them. Nor do I plan on getting 
dragged into their so-called opera.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: All I will do is race with you.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: And in the race, I will win. —That is all.
